title: A Study to Evaluate Surovatamig Combined With R-CHOP in Participants of 18 to < 80 Years of Age With Previously Untreated Large B-cell Lymphoma With IPI Score 2 to 5
official: A Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Surovatamig Combined With Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, and Prednisone (R-CHOP) in Previously Untreated Large B-cell Lymphoma (Soundtrack D3)
summary: This is a study to evaluate the efficacy of surovatamig combined with rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisone (R-CHOP) in participants aged 18 to \< 80 years of age with previously untreated large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) with International Prognostic Index (IPI) score 2 to 5.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Histologically confirmed previously untreated large B-cell lymphoma.
2. IPI score of 2 to 5.
3. Measurable disease.
4. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 to 2.
5. Adequate organ function.
6. Availability of tumour tissue.
7. Meets protocol-defined contraception and pregnancy requirements.

Exclusion Criteria

1. Prior systemic treatment for large B-cell lymphoma.
2. Primary or secondary central nervous system lymphoma.
3. Active uncontrolled infection.
4. Significant uncontrolled medical condition that may interfere with study participation.
5. Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment.
6. History of clinically significant interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
7. Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
8. Known hypersensitivity to study treatment components.
